heroHeadline: Turkey to Hand Over Bashiqa Base as Iraq Bars Iranian Flights and US Coalition Exit Nears
heroSubtitle: With the September 30 coalition withdrawal deadline days away, Turkey agreed (Sept 23, UNGA sidelines) to gradually hand the long-disputed Bashiqa-Zelikan base near Mosul to Iraqi federal control in exchange for Baghdad removing PKK-affiliated armed groups from Sinjar. On September 25 the US transferred its Diplomatic Support Centre at Baghdad airport to Iraq, while Najaf, Erbil and Sulaimaniya joined Baghdad in suspending Iranian carrier flights to enforce new US aviation sanctions, closing every major Iraqi airport to Iran. PM Ali al-Zaidi used his UN General Assembly address to pitch an 'invest with Iraq' economic vision and energy links with Turkey, Jordan and Syria, even as an adviser denied any fixed deadline for militia disarmament beyond the coalition exit and the parallel-market dollar pushed past 160,000 dinars per $100 — a 22% premium over the official peg — amid tightened US Treasury pressure on Iraq's dollar-reserve access.
